read.thesis: Record $192B Q2 inflows and 45.9% adjusted operating margin, with buybacks raised to at least $550M per quarter; but this is an asset manager, so the supply-side capital-cycle framework applies poorly and no capacity data is disclosed.

triggers.label: Buybacks raised to ≥$550M/qtr
triggers.quote: we anticipate repurchasing at least $550 million of shares per quarter going forward, higher than our previous guidance communicated in January

triggers.label: Q2 net inflows $192B, more than double
triggers.quote: Clients entrusted BlackRock with $192 billion of net inflows in the second quarter

triggers.label: Operating margin 45.9%, up 260bp
triggers.quote: Our operating margin of 45.9% expanded 260 basis points from a year ago and reached its highest level in nearly five years.

triggers.label: Institutional index outflows $41B
triggers.quote: Institutional index net outflows of $41 billion were concentrated in low-fee index equities.

guidance.quote: We continue to target a 45% or greater adjusted operating margin
we anticipate repurchasing at least $550 million of shares per quarter going forward
we expect to return over $5.7 billion to shareholders this year, which is a 16% increase over 2025

guidance.value: mid-single-digit % after annualizing HPS and Preqin
guidance.quote: we continue to expect a mid-single-digit percentage increase in full-year G&A
We continue to estimate that 25% is a reasonable projected tax run rate for the remainder of 2026.
We remain committed to low to mid-teens ACV growth over the long term.
As part of our 2030 plan, we're aiming to make this a $500 million revenue business at BlackRock.

red_flags.label: Market-beta dependence acknowledged
red_flags.quote: The markets, of course, might continue to have an impact on our margins, both up and down

red_flags.label: Private credit scrutiny
red_flags.quote: Obviously there's a lot of headlines related to the retail side of it.

evasions.quote: Obviously there's a lot of headlines related to the retail side of it.
